error_type_detail: E4-S4 AC1 unreachable: /customer/questionnaire has no matching <Route> in frontend/src/router.tsx.
expected: GET (navigate to) /customer/questionnaire renders Questionnaire.tsx, which fetches GET /api/risk-profile/questionnaire and renders one control group per question with Submit disabled until all are answered.
actual: Reproduced live with a real Chromium session (Playwright 1.63.0) driving http://localhost:5173 against http://localhost:8000, logged in as alice.reyes@wealthwise.test (customer). Navigating to /customer/questionnaire renders a completely blank page: page.title() = 'WealthWise', page.locator('body').innerText() = '' (empty string) - not even the NavBar/Layout chrome that every other protected route renders. This is because frontend/src/router.tsx's <Routes> block (lines 38-91) has no <Route path="/customer/questionnaire"> entry at all, and there is no catch-all/path="*" route either, so React Router matches nothing and renders nothing.
stack_trace: frontend/src/router.tsx:36-93 - the <Routes> element only registers /login, /, /customer/dashboard, /customer/holdings, /advisor/customers, /admin, /compliance/audit-log. Questionnaire.tsx (frontend/src/pages/customer/Questionnaire.tsx) exists and is never imported into router.tsx. Confirmed via `grep -n "Questionnaire" frontend/src/router.tsx` returning no matches.
files_likely_involved: frontend/src/router.tsx (needs a new <Route path="/customer/questionnaire"> importing Questionnaire.tsx)
frontend/src/components/NavBar.tsx (has no link to the questionnaire for the customer role - only 'Holdings' is linked)
test_coverage_gap: Questionnaire.test.tsx renders <Questionnaire /> directly (unit-level, mocked API), so it never exercises router.tsx and never caught the missing registration. No test in this codebase renders <AppRouter /> and navigates by URL, which is the only thing that would have caught this class of bug before live evaluation.
